blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Metropolitan Cebu Water District (MCWD) is preparing measures to address a possible daily production shortfall of 50 million liters under a worst-case scenario, as prolonged dry conditions could significantly reduce output from its surface water sources. Engineer Rainier Quiñones, MCWD department manager for Production and Distribution, said the district was working to make up for the projected deficit through new water supply arrangements, expansion of existing sources, and operational improvements.
